Basicly an upgrade for netherite for late game.The idea is overtime chorus fruit deep under ground turned into a chorusite fossil. Our frist project so don't expect much.Made By NamOmurik,textures by Largish_Sculk.

All items uses 2547(Chorusite Sword,Chorusite Axe,Chorusite Pickaxe,Chorusite Shovel,Chorusite Hoe,Chorusite Helmet,Chorusite Chestplate,Chorusite Leggings,Chorusite Boots)
